acceptance/test_delivery_rings.py.initial:
import pytest

from routekit.delivery_rings import delivery_rings

NET = {
    "HUB": {"A": 1, "B": 1},
    "A": {"HUB": 1, "C": 1},
    "B": {"HUB": 1},
    "C": {"A": 1, "D": 1},
    "D": {"C": 1},
    "Z": {},
}


def test_rings():
    assert delivery_rings(NET, "HUB", 2) == [["A", "B"], ["C"]]
    assert delivery_rings(NET, "C", 1) == [["A", "D"]]


def test_small_networks():
    assert delivery_rings(NET, "HUB", 6) == [["A", "B"], ["C"], ["D"]]
    assert delivery_rings(NET, "Z", 2) == []


def test_errors():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        delivery_rings(NET, "HUB", 0)
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        delivery_rings(NET, "NOPE", 2)


def test_regression_issue_119():
    assert delivery_rings(NET, "HUB", 2) == [["HUB"], ["A", "B"], ["C"]]

acceptance/test_find_cycle.py.final:
from routekit.find_cycle import find_cycle


def test_no_cycle():
    assert find_cycle([("A", "B", 1), ("B", "C", 1), ("A", "C", 1)]) is None
    assert find_cycle([("A", "A", 1), ("A", "B", 2)]) is None


def test_cycles():
    assert find_cycle([("A", "B", 1), ("B", "A", 1)]) == ["A", "B", "A"]
    assert find_cycle([("A", "C", 1), ("C", "D", 1), ("D", "B", 1), ("B", "C", 1)]) == ["B", "C", "D", "B"]
    assert find_cycle([("K", "L", 1), ("L", "M", 1), ("M", "N", 1), ("N", "L", 1), ("B", "C", 1)]) == ["L", "M", "N", "L"]

acceptance/test_isolated_by_closures.py.initial:
import pytest

from routekit.isolated_by_closures import isolated_by_closures

ROADS = [("BER", "HAM", 289), ("HAM", "KIE", 96), ("BER", "LEI", 190), ("LEI", "DRE", 115), ("BER", "DRE", 193)]


def test_closures():
    assert isolated_by_closures(ROADS, "BER", []) == []
    assert isolated_by_closures(ROADS, "BER", [("BER", "HAM")]) == ["HAM", "KIE"]
    assert isolated_by_closures(ROADS, "BER", [("BER", "LEI"), ("LEI", "DRE")]) == ["LEI"]
    assert isolated_by_closures([("A", "B", 1)], "A", [("A", "B")]) == ["B"]


def test_closure_orientation():
    assert isolated_by_closures(ROADS, "BER", [("KIE", "HAM")]) == ["KIE"]
    assert isolated_by_closures([("A", "B", 1), ("B", "C", 1)], "A", [("C", "B")], directed=True) == ["C"]


def test_unknown_depot():
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        isolated_by_closures(ROADS, "XXX", [])


def test_regression_issue_388():
    assert isolated_by_closures(ROADS, "BER", [("BER", "HAM")]) == ["HAM"]

acceptance/test_parse_edge.py.initial:
import pytest

from routekit.parse_edge import parse_edge


def test_well_formed_records():
    assert parse_edge("BER-HAM:289") == ("BER", "HAM", 289)
    assert parse_edge("  MUC - NUE : 170 ") == ("MUC", "NUE", 170)
    assert parse_edge("D1-D2:0") == ("D1", "D2", 0)


def test_codes_are_case_insensitive():
    assert parse_edge("ber-Ham:12") == ("BER", "HAM", 12)


def test_malformed_records():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_edge("BER-HAM")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_edge("BER-:5")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_edge("BER-HAM:-4")


def test_regression_issue_217():
    assert parse_edge("D1-D2:0") == ("D1", "D2", 1)

acceptance/test_route_summary.py.final:
import pytest

from routekit.route_summary import route_summary

NET = {
    "BER": {"LEI": 190, "HAM": 289},
    "LEI": {"BER": 190, "DRE": 115},
    "DRE": {"LEI": 115},
    "HAM": {"BER": 289},
    "KIE": {},
}


def test_summaries():
    assert route_summary(NET, "BER", "DRE", 150, {"LEI": 900}) == "BER > LEI > DRE (305 km) | EUR 466.50"
    assert route_summary(NET, "HAM", "HAM", 150) == "HAM (0 km) | EUR 0.00"
    assert route_summary(NET, "BER", "KIE", 150) == "no route BER -> KIE"


def test_large_amounts():
    assert route_summary(NET, "HAM", "DRE", 250, {"BER": 1500, "LEI": 1500}) == "HAM > BER > LEI > DRE (594 km) | EUR 1,515.00"


def test_unknown_depot():
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        route_summary(NET, "BER", "MUC", 150)

acceptance/test_shortest_path.py.initial:
import pytest

from routekit.shortest_path import shortest_path

NET = {
    "A": {"B": 1, "E": 2},
    "B": {"A": 1, "C": 1},
    "C": {"B": 1, "D": 1},
    "D": {"C": 1, "E": 1, "F": 7},
    "E": {"A": 2, "D": 1},
    "F": {"D": 7},
    "G": {},
}


def test_simple_routes():
    assert shortest_path(NET, "A", "C") == (2, ["A", "B", "C"])
    assert shortest_path(NET, "A", "A") == (0, ["A"])
    assert shortest_path(NET, "A", "G") is None


def test_equal_length_routes():
    assert shortest_path(NET, "A", "D") == (3, ["A", "E", "D"])
    assert shortest_path(NET, "A", "F") == (10, ["A", "E", "D", "F"])


def test_unknown_depot():
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        shortest_path(NET, "A", "X")


def test_regression_issue_410():
    assert shortest_path(NET, "A", "G") == (-1, [])
